results.description:
Acrobits Groundwire: Elevate Your Communication

Acrobits, a leader in UCaaS and communication solutions for over 20 years, proudly introduces the Acrobits Groundwire softphone. This top-tier SIP softphone client offers unmatched voice and video call clarity. A softphone designed for both personal and professional use, it seamlessly integrates quality communication with an intuitive interface.

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ

Groundwire is a SIP Client, not a VoIP service. You must have service with a VoIP provider or PBX that supports use on a standard SIP client to use it.

Choosing the Best Softphone App

Experience robust communication with a leading SIP softphone application. Preconfigured for major VoIP providers, this softphone app guarantees high-quality, secure, and intuitive calling. Perfect for maintaining connections with friends, family, and colleagues, maximizing all aspects of your VoIP experience.

Key Features of the SIP Softphone
- Exceptional Audio Quality: Enjoy crystal clear audio with support for multiple formats including Opus and G.729.
- HD Video Calls: Conduct up to 720p HD video calls, supported by H.264 and VP8.
- Robust Security: Our SIP softphone app ensures private conversations with military-grade encryption.
- Battery Efficiency: Thanks to our efficient push notifications, you can stay connected with minimal battery drain.
- Seamless Call Transition: Our VoIP dialer smoothly switches between WiFi and data plans during calls.
- Softphone Customization: Tailor your SIP settings, UI, and ringtones.
- 5G and Multi-Device Support: Ready for the future, compatible with most mobile operating systems.

Other features included on this robust app include: instant messaging, attended and unattended transfers, group calls, voicemail, and extensive customization for each SIP account. 

More Than Just a VoIP Softphone Dialer

Groundwire softphone offers more than the standard VoIP dialer experience. It’s a comprehensive tool for crystal clear Wi-Fi calling, equipped with robust business VoIP dialer features. It offers a secure and reliable softphone choice with no hidden fees and a one-time cost. Leverage SIP technology for improved call quality. Make this softphone your first choice for dependable, and easy SIP communication.

Download a feature-rich and modern SIP softphone now and be part of a community enjoying the best in voice and SIP calling. Transform your daily communication with our exceptional VoIP softphone app.

Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter.

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ

Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients.

Business calling features

Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone:

- Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation.
- Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over.
- Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension.
- Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you.
- Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call.
- Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly.

Works with your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network.

On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket.

Key features of the softphone

- Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them.
- Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8.
- Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP.
- Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications.
- The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them.
- Custom call settings, UI, and ringtones per account.
- 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems.

A softphone app without the fees

Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it.

Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers.

Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.
